name: Rajarshri Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Fee Reimbursement Scheme.
description: The scheme provides course fee reimbursement for students applying for MBBS,BDS,BAMS,BHMS,BPTH,BOTH,B.SC Nursing, BUMS, BP & O, BASLP in government aided/Corporation/Private un-aided colleges. Beneficiary Category: EBC Eligible Courses: MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BPTH ,BOTH,B.SC Nursing, BUMS, BP & O, BASLP in government aided/Corporation/Private un-aided colleges.
